Keep snapshot/reuse reliability planned as a prerequisite for any later confirmation, the historical memory audit deferred, build mode gated and independent transfer waiting; no external action is authorized.

categories.assessment: The two-family E0 screen is the smallest fresh semantic experiment supported by the retained independent implementation. Confirmation remains separate and gated by snapshot/reuse reliability.

The selected screen reuses the supervised LazyLean adapter and adds bounded delta/iota evidence. The eighteen-receipt memory interpretation gap and confirmation closure defects remain separate retained work.
No substantive upstream feedback or maintenance emergency displaces this bounded local screen. Snapshot/reuse repair remains the concrete local prerequisite for confirmation.

The campaign reuses pinned LazyLean source, a reviewed portability build, the fail-closed adapter, process supervisor and a retained canonical True recursor shape; no new literature method is needed for this screen.
The E0 entry gates are now concrete and executable. Snapshot/reuse repair is deliberately reserved for confirmation; build mode and transfer retain exact unsatisfied gates.
